text_en: The door is damaged. See if you can restore power to it with a nearby element.
We need to reach the next room. Try to clear the way for us by disabling the turrets. They are out of control.
Try to restart the generators with the minerals.
If those cowards had attacked us head-on, we wouldn't have had to even begin fighting them. We are a race of hunters, that is why we are here. But now our prey is another.
